comment: Add auth.popupRelayUri: a double-popup option for apps that customize COOP/storage-partitioning, relaying acquireTokenPopup/logoutPopup through a top-level same-origin relay page (runPopupRelay) so tokens can be acquired from an untrusted cross-origin iframe. [#8687](https://github.com/AzureAD/microsoft-authentication-library-for-js/pull/8687)
